name: eou-timing
title: Design EOU configuration updates independent from backchanneling
description: Minimum and maximum wait as configurable values: the global default shown beside the detection model that uses them, and the persona that inherits until it overrides. Bounded ranges, plain-language help and the out-of-band warning, scoped to the PRD's requirements.
